port_notes: grouping.py is byte-identical to the published engine.
Observed resolver retains source IDs and reference quaternions; added immutable saved-trial reconstruction.
Member assessment retains published retention and representative-selection rules; added checkpoint input/source validation, retained events, separate classification fields and display-ID crosswalk.
Source poses use recorded compatible anchors, otherwise first settled trial.
